subject.title: feat(dashboard): add Bay journey timing and portrait layout

question: Should OpenClaw Bay adopt explicit review and re-review command journeys as its supported trigger-to-final-review latency metric, together with the portrait layout?
rationale: The implementation is technically sound, but choosing this deliberately narrow KPI and making it part of the dashboard contract is a product and operations decision rather than a correctness repair.

options.title: Adopt the proposed Bay metric
options.body: Accept explicit review and re-review commands as the bounded latency sample and land the portrait layout with the supplied proof and migration coverage.

options.title: Land portrait only
options.body: Keep the mobile layout improvement but defer journey-state persistence until maintainers choose the dashboard latency definition.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the existing completed-job placeholder until a broader dashboard metrics design is agreed.

recommendation.title: Adopt the proposed Bay metric
recommendation.body: Accept explicit review and re-review commands as the bounded latency sample and land the portrait layout with the supplied proof and migration coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice defines the supported dashboard KPI and product surface rather than requiring a mechanical code repair.
